title: KServe V2 Starlink QoE inference request
description: Request schema for the supplied ONNX QoE transformer served by MLServer under KServe V2.

name.description: KServe tensor name read from deployed ONNX model metadata; the supplied pipeline exports input.

prefixItems.description: Fixed singleton axis from the trained tensor shape.

datatype.description: KServe V2 FP32 input tensor type.

items.description: Feature order: latitude, longitude, elevation_m, visible_satellites, serving_satellites, signal_loss_db, season_encoded, weather_encoded.
One singleton-axis feature tensor for a customer/location.

data.description: Data shape is [batch, 1, 8] and aligns with the request shape.

InputTensor.description: QoE tensor after StandardScaler and season/weather label encoding using the external preprocessing sidecars.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

name.description: KServe output tensor name reported by the ONNX metadata; the supplied pipeline exports output.

prefixItems.description: Number of QoE scores; equals input batch size.
One score from the transformer's final linear layer.

shape.description: Two-dimensional output shape [batch, 1] exported by the supplied Starlink transformer.

datatype.description: ONNX metadata supplies the numeric score datatype; prediction-tools normalizes it to a numeric score. Exact artifact metadata is an open question.

items.description: One QoE score on the model's 0–100 scale.

data.description: Flattened KServe tensor data: one numeric score per input customer/location, preserving input order. The data length equals the batch dimension even though shape is [batch, 1].

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

id.description: Request ID echoed by the inference server.

model_version.description: Served artifact version, recorded with prediction results.

x-contract-guarantees.side_effects: Stateless inference; the model service does not mutate application database rows.
x-contract-guarantees.errors: Invalid tensor, model not ready, invalid model name, missing preprocessing sidecar, and storage errors map to typed KServe errors.
x-contract-guarantees.timeouts_retries: Prediction-tools sets a 30 second per-batch deadline and retries one transient readiness/5xx failure after 500 milliseconds; invalid tensors and missing preprocessing artifacts are not retried.
x-contract-guarantees.ordering: Exactly one scalar score in [0, 100] is returned per input row and input order is preserved.
x-contract-guarantees.versioning: KServe V2 schema, ordered eight-feature preprocessing manifest, scaler, label encoders, and ONNX artifact are versioned together.

x-preprocessing.transform: Read scaler.joblib and label_encoders.joblib from the configured external S3 artifact prefix; apply StandardScaler and season/weather encoding before constructing the tensor.
x-preprocessing.data_domain: The supplied model is trained on Starlink satellite internet samples; telecom QoE data is a future enhancement.
x-preprocessing.unresolved_artifact_metadata: Confirm the deployed model version and tensor metadata against the artifact manifest. The supplied pipeline exports input/output tensor names input/output and stores the fitted sidecars under artifacts/scaler.joblib and artifacts/label_encoders.joblib.
